intervention_design.AGGREGATE_ONLY: Replace only mt['confidence'] with the frozen profile confidence; leave weekly state confidence unchanged.
intervention_design.WEEKLY_AND_AGGREGATE: Apply both controlled MT-output interventions before the rest of StockIntelligenceService executes.
intervention_design.WEEKLY_ONLY: Replace only mt['states']['1w'].confidence with the frozen weekly confidence after native MT analyze returns; leave mt['confidence'] unchanged.
intervention_design.purpose: Determine whether weekly confidence is re-read downstream, whether aggregate MT confidence is the direct source of profile confidence, and whether confidence repair alone restores score/state parity.
